name: Wildfire and Forest Resilience Directed Grant Program
summary: Proposition 4 grants for forest-health planning and implementation projects in the Sierra-Cascade region that make forests and watersheds more resilient and reduce wildfire risk; projects start with a concept proposal and a conversation with an SNC area representative.

status.quote: Concept Proposals are due by 5pm on July 27, 2026.

deadline.quote: Concept Proposals are due by 5pm on July 27, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants: public agencies, including federal agencies qualifying 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations tribal entities recognized on the current United States Federal Register or the Native American Heritage Commission as a California Native American tribe

geography.quote: Be located within the Sierra-Cascade region as defined by current SNC governing legislation.

access.quote: To initiate consideration of a project, contact the appropriate SNC Area Representative to discuss the project idea.
